message.content: {"key_mechanism_gt": "Conjugating a squaraine dye photosensitizer with folic acid enables specific uptake by folate receptor-overexpressing cancer cells, leading to enhanced photodynamic cytotoxicity upon irradiation while maintaining biocompatibility in normal cells.", "key_mechanism_gen": "The folate moiety binds specifically to overexpressed folate receptors on the tumor cell membrane, facilitating receptor-mediated endocytosis and internalization of the conjugated photosensitizer.", "recovery": "RECOVERED", "rationale": "Both hypotheses describe the same core mechanism: folate receptor-mediated endocytosis of the conjugated photosensitizer in tumor cells, leading to selective cytotoxicity."}
